about: Cell text: each float column's budget as the GPUI contender laid it out (its ColumnProbe); values from the data file with the exact text and the shown text the contender drew (cells, written by apps/observatory/perf/cell-fixture.ts); synthetic values the same columns round (rounding, kept by it); with resize, GPUI's widest number advance (number_px) and widths with the budgets they give (resize, both kept by it); and each scenario on a feature level its own columns and cells, drawn at its default stop (scenarios). See README.md.

source.contender: tall-table-gpui, release build, Chromium, 2560x900 at DPR 2 (budgets the same at DPR 1)

rounding.why: rounded text is never the same float
rounding carries past the budget: scientific
a whole part too long: scientific
plain while it keeps 3 digits or more
a tie rounds to even (JS's toFixed rounds it up)
two shortest texts equally near: the exact text takes the upper (JS's String takes the even)

widths.why: below the min: clamped up to it
past the max: clamped down to it

cells.why: at the min, the magnitude alone (wider than its budget: GPUI cuts it)
narrowed: decimals cut to the budget
narrowed: an integer part past the budget goes to exponent form
narrowed: a small value goes to exponent form
widened: a value rounded at the kind's width shown whole

source.contender: tall-table-gpui at the wide level, release build, Chromium, 2560x900 at DPR 2 (budgets the same at DPR 1)
